_comment: Hooks for apple-plugin. PostToolUse: the edited .swift file (generated *.generated.swift / *.pb.swift skipped) is formatted with the tool the project configured — `swift format --in-place` when .swift-format exists, `swiftformat` when .swiftformat exists, nothing otherwise — through sdlc/hooks/run-tool.sh (local toolchain on PATH first, then a running Docker Compose service; skipped silently when neither has the tool or the project has no Swift marker). PreToolUse: config protection. SubagentStop: batched `swiftlint lint` after the architect when the project has .swiftlint.yml. There is no compile hook: xcodebuild needs a scheme and destination only the architect can pick, so apple-architect runs the build itself.

hooks.command: f=$(jq -j '.tool_input.file_path // empty' 2>/dev/null || python3 -c 'import json,sys; sys.stdout.write(json.load(sys.stdin)["tool_input"]["file_path"])' 2>/dev/null); case "$f" in *.swift) case "$f" in *.generated.swift|*.pb.swift) exit 0;; esac; s=$(bash -c 'n=run-tool.sh; r="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}"; bs=\\; r="${r//"$bs"//}"; s=""; if [ -n "$r" ]; then for c in "$r/../sdlc/hooks/$n" "$r/../../sdlc/${r##*/}/hooks/$n" "$r"/../../sdlc/*/hooks/"$n"; do if [ -f "$c" ] && [ ! -e "${c%/hooks/*}/.orphaned_at" ]; then s="$c"; break; fi; done; fi; if [ -z "$s" ] && [ -f "${PWD}/plugins/sdlc/hooks/$n" ]; then s="${PWD}/plugins/sdlc/hooks/$n"; fi; printf %s "$s"'); [ -n "$s" ] || exit 0; if [ -f .swift-format ]; then bash "$s" --lang swift --quiet -- swift format --in-place "$f"; elif [ -f .swiftformat ]; then bash "$s" --lang swift --quiet -- swiftformat "$f"; fi; exit 0;; esac

bash -c 'n=config-protection.sh; r="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}"; bs=\\; r="${r//"$bs"//}"; s=""; if [ -n "$r" ]; then for c in "$r/../sdlc/hooks/$n" "$r/../../sdlc/${r##*/}/hooks/$n" "$r"/../../sdlc/*/hooks/"$n"; do if [ -f "$c" ] && [ ! -e "${c%/hooks/*}/.orphaned_at" ]; then s="$c"; break; fi; done; fi; if [ -z "$s" ] && [ -f "${PWD}/plugins/sdlc/hooks/$n" ]; then s="${PWD}/plugins/sdlc/hooks/$n"; fi; if [ -n "$s" ]; then exec bash "$s" '.swiftlint.yml' '.swift-format' '.swiftformat'; fi; exit 0'
hooks.description: Protect this stack's tooling config (.swiftlint.yml;.swift-format;.swiftformat) from being edited mid-run to make a diff pass. Denies only while an sdlc run state file is fresh and task_type is not chore; silent otherwise.

hooks.command: bash -c 'n=post-implement-check.sh; r="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}"; bs=\\; r="${r//"$bs"//}"; s=""; if [ -n "$r" ]; then for c in "$r/../sdlc/hooks/$n" "$r/../../sdlc/${r##*/}/hooks/$n" "$r"/../../sdlc/*/hooks/"$n"; do if [ -f "$c" ] && [ ! -e "${c%/hooks/*}/.orphaned_at" ]; then s="$c"; break; fi; done; fi; if [ -z "$s" ] && [ -f "${PWD}/plugins/sdlc/hooks/$n" ]; then s="${PWD}/plugins/sdlc/hooks/$n"; fi; if [ -n "$s" ] && [ -f .swiftlint.yml ]; then exec bash "$s" --lang swift -- swiftlint lint --quiet; fi; exit 0'
hooks.description: Batched post-implement check: runs `swiftlint lint --quiet` once after this stack's architect finishes, only when the project has .swiftlint.yml, and relays violations to the orchestrator as a retry hint. Silent when SwiftLint is not installed, the project has no SwiftLint config, or no run is active.
